integrity: Self-contained analytic proof and an exact-rational witness checker. No independent audit or experimental universality claim.
scientific_limitations: The sharp uniform bound is proved only for the Case-I subspace direction with positive-definite secant relation and its stated guard. The exact affine example demonstrates failure of the next line search, not a failure claim for all branches or parameter choices.
title: Sharp secant-safeguard boundary for a subspace conjugate-gradient direction
